---
title: "Ricercar"
year: 2016

dedication: "to Monika Charkowska"
score: "/assets/scores/Ricercar.zip"
---
*Ricercar* is an algorithmic work for solo timpani generated by a computer program. Because this program uses random procedures, a different version of this work is output at each execution. It is
recommended that the performer generate a new version for each concert (more on how to generate a version below), though this is not a requirement. Also, the performer may play more than one
single version on a same concert.
